analysis.RQ2_decision: INCONCLUSIVE_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_TESTED: no defensible margin; estimation only
analysis.ci: nominal two-sided 95% t plus simultaneous Bonferroni 99.1666667% t for six contrasts
analysis.multiplicity: Holm family of all six contrasts; alpha=0.05
analysis.primary_estimand: seed-equal mean of interval-entry rates per post-first-fused-acquisition observation minute; identical P1 numerator/exposure definitions
analysis.sensitivity: exact all-16384 seed sign flips (sign-symmetry assumption, not randomized assignment); seed-block bootstrap with fixed RNG
analysis.strict_los_onset: sensitivity only: actual clear-to-blocked transition, excluding left-prevalent/FOV-reentry entries
analysis.terminal_sensitivity: report outcomes/exposure separately; fixed first 1/2/5s post-acquisition restricted observed exposure, no counterfactual after termination
analysis.test: one-sided paired Student t on 14 seed-level rate differences, df=13
analysis.unsupported_duration_tail: NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_RISK_SET, reported separately from the numerical KM plateau
analysis.zero_seed_variance: t inference and CI NOT_ESTIMABLE; conservative 1 only for Holm family bookkeeping, contrast INCONCLUSIVE

authority: User explicitly approves local preregistration/analysis commit and, after passing preregistered conditions, this exact GPU main run without a further approval. No merge/push/PPO/Planner/deletion.

decisions.RQ1: SUPPORTED iff both primary contrasts SUPPORTED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (per-lineage decisions retained)
decisions.RQ2: INCONCLUSIVE_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_TESTED regardless nonsignificance; no equivalence inference
decisions.RQ3: SUPPORTED iff all four secondary contrasts SUPPORTED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (per-density decisions retained)
decisions.per_contrast: SUPPORTED iff mean>0 and Holm p<0.05, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; CONTRADICTED if simultaneous CI upper<0
